text:
Predicates:
Born(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
Player(x) ::: x is a football player.
LoanedOutTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to club y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for club y.
Club(x) ::: x is a football club.
Premises:
Born(ailtonSilva, 1995) ∧ LoanedOutTo(ailtonSilva, braga) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton. Ailton is a football player who was loaned out to Braga. Ailton Silva is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Nautico.
PlaysFor(nautico, nautico) ∧ PlaysFor(braga, braga) ::: Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
Conclusion:
¬PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, fluminense) ::: Ailton Silva played for Fluminense.
